name: Zoop Zoop Bee Adventures 7
author: Garrett Hale
description: Defend your meadows from Dick Dastardly Duck as a bee, with team and solo high scores. Drop-in play for up to 4 bees with several gamepads. X to start, arrows to move.

descriptions.en: Defend your meadows from Dick Dastardly Duck as a bee, with team and solo high scores. Drop-in play for up to 4 bees with several gamepads. X to start, arrows to move.
descriptions.it: Difendi i tuoi prati da Dick Dastardly Duck nei panni di un'ape, con record a squadre e in solitario. Fino a 4 api con più joypad. X per iniziare, frecce per muoverti.
